snippet.title: GTA 6 Physical Edition Unboxing! What's Inside the Box? 👀
snippet.description:
What if GTA 6 came with a physical Collector's Edition for PS5? 👀

Well, I decided to make one myself!

In this video, we're unboxing my custom-made GTA VI physical collector-style edition and taking a closer look at everything packed inside.

**What's inside?*
- Custom PS5 blue case with GTA VI cover artwork
- Custom-designed disc label
- 12-page GTA VI booklet
- 2 exclusive collector cards
- 6 GTA VI art prints

From the cover artwork to the smallest details inside the case, everything was put together as a DIY collector's project.

This is a fan-made collectible, not an official Rockstar Games product. It does not include a playable game, game licence or download code.

Would you buy something like this? Let me know in the comments!
